title: Cumulus Cloud Ka 480 Km Bada Sach
idea: Cumulus clouds can form massive cloud streets stretching up to 480 kilometres long.

lines.text: Kya aapne aasman mein ek sath itna bada badal dekha hai?
Aasman mein dikhne wale safed cumulus badal koi aam badal nahi hain.
Yeh badal lagatar judkar 480 kilometre lambi cloud streets bana sakte hain!
Yeh doori Mumbai se Goa tak ke pure raste jitni lambi hoti hai!
Itna hi nahi, yeh badal zameen se 2000 meter se kam unchai par hote hain.
Kya aapne kabhi itne lambe badal dekhe hain? Comment mein batao!

youtube.title: Cumulus Cloud Kitna Bada Ho Sakta Hai? ☁️ #shorts
youtube.description: Kya aapko pata hai ki cumulus cloud 480 km tak lambi cloud streets bana sakte hain? Jaaniye badalon ke is hairan kar dene wale sach ke baare mein! #shorts #cumuluscloud #facts #weather #science

facts.claim: Cumulus clouds can form lines stretching over 480 km called cloud streets
Cumulus clouds are low-level clouds generally less than 2000 m in altitude
